retention: Comparison JSON and Markdown are byte-identical outputs of the maintained zetesis-series viewer. Raw reports are identified by SHA-256 and byte count. This projection retains campaign plans, limits, workload identities, clocks and outcomes without terminal streams or machine-local paths.
interpretation: ABBA observations of the integrated executables. CPU-auto uses 22 derived-series cells; CPU-eager and Metal-eager use the same three baseline corpus cases. Phase intervals are host measurements, not device kernel timing. Primitive work counts differ between general propagation and tight support and do not establish an instruction-count or speedup ratio.
